tools.description:
Keep scored cells with score >= threshold and merge touching kept cells (8- or 4-neighbour) into sites.
Returns sites, unreviewed grid area, and a count range. low counts sites at or above the higher of the
threshold and the 75th percentile of kept scores; high counts all sites. scored_cells: [{cell_id, score}].
tools.name: aggregate

tools.description:
Build (or reuse) a grid of embedding cells for a source, cell size (m) and year over aoi_bbox (default:
the task AOI). Returns an index_id, the cell count and provenance. Only allow-listed sources.
tools.name: build_index

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.
tools.name: classify

tools.description:
Up to n permitted few-shot positive examples (id, lon, lat) from the training split. Other splits are
refused. May return none when the area has no labelled examples.
tools.name: get_examples

tools.description:
Read a square window of side_m metres centred on lon/lat from a scene, resampled to out_px x out_px.
        effective_gsd_m = max(side_m / out_px, pixel_spacing_m) is the detail you actually see (upsampling
        adds none); the image follows the metadata.

tools.description:

tools.description:

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).

descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model

(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.

request.system: You are a geospatial investigation agent. Choose your own strategy using the task and observations. Before each tool action, call record_decision with a new unique action_id label, the exact tool and the exact parameters you will then send, concise rationale, alternatives actually considered, and confidence; the decision binds to your next call with identical tool and parameters. Cite only prior successful result IDs. A decision is consumed by one action. Use record_claim to build the database; confidence is your own estimate. Explain uncertainty, data scale, gaps, revisions and stopping with note_limitation. Decision explanations are self-reports, not proof of hidden internal reasoning.

tools.description:
Keep scored cells with score >= threshold and merge touching kept cells (8- or 4-neighbour) into sites.
Returns sites, unreviewed grid area, and a count range. low counts sites at or above the higher of the
threshold and the 75th percentile of kept scores; high counts all sites. scored_cells: [{cell_id, score}].
tools.name: aggregate

tools.description:
Build (or reuse) a grid of embedding cells for a source, cell size (m) and year over aoi_bbox (default:
the task AOI). Returns an index_id, the cell count and provenance. Only allow-listed sources.
tools.name: build_index

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.
tools.name: classify

tools.description:
Up to n permitted few-shot positive examples (id, lon, lat) from the training split. Other splits are
refused. May return none when the area has no labelled examples.
tools.name: get_examples

tools.description:
Read a square window of side_m metres centred on lon/lat from a scene, resampled to out_px x out_px.
        effective_gsd_m = max(side_m / out_px, pixel_spacing_m) is the detail you actually see (upsampling
        adds none); the image follows the metadata.
tools.name: imagery_window

tools.description:
Keep scored cells with score >= threshold and merge touching kept cells (8- or 4-neighbour) into sites.
Returns sites, unreviewed grid area, and a count range. low counts sites at or above the higher of the
threshold and the 75th percentile of kept scores; high counts all sites. scored_cells: [{cell_id, score}].
tools.name: aggregate

tools.description:
Build (or reuse) a grid of embedding cells for a source, cell size (m) and year over aoi_bbox (default:
the task AOI). Returns an index_id, the cell count and provenance. Only allow-listed sources.
tools.name: build_index

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.
tools.name: classify

tools.description:
Up to n permitted few-shot positive examples (id, lon, lat) from the training split. Other splits are
refused. May return none when the area has no labelled examples.
tools.name: get_examples

tools.description:
Read a square window of side_m metres centred on lon/lat from a scene, resampled to out_px x out_px.
        effective_gsd_m = max(side_m / out_px, pixel_spacing_m) is the detail you actually see (upsampling
        adds none); the image follows the metadata.
tools.name: imagery_window

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.

tools.description:
Keep scored cells with score >= threshold and merge touching kept cells (8- or 4-neighbour) into sites.
Returns sites, unreviewed grid area, and a count range. low counts sites at or above the higher of the
threshold and the 75th percentile of kept scores; high counts all sites. scored_cells: [{cell_id, score}].

tools.description:
Build (or reuse) a grid of embedding cells for a source, cell size (m) and year over aoi_bbox (default:
the task AOI). Returns an index_id, the cell count and provenance. Only allow-listed sources.
tools.name: build_index

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.
tools.name: classify

tools.description:
Up to n permitted few-shot positive examples (id, lon, lat) from the training split. Other splits are
refused. May return none when the area has no labelled examples.
tools.name: get_examples

tools.description:
Read a square window of side_m metres centred on lon/lat from a scene, resampled to out_px x out_px.
        effective_gsd_m = max(side_m / out_px, pixel_spacing_m) is the detail you actually see (upsampling
        adds none); the image follows the metadata.

tools.description:

Returns sites, unreviewed grid area, and a count range. low counts sites at or above the higher of the

tools.description:

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.

tools.description:
Keep scored cells with score >= threshold and merge touching kept cells (8- or 4-neighbour) into sites.
Returns sites, unreviewed grid area, and a count range. low counts sites at or above the higher of the
threshold and the 75th percentile of kept scores; high counts all sites. scored_cells: [{cell_id, score}].

tools.description:
Build (or reuse) a grid of embedding cells for a source, cell size (m) and year over aoi_bbox (default:
the task AOI). Returns an index_id, the cell count and provenance. Only allow-listed sources.
tools.name: build_index

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.
tools.name: classify

tools.description:

refused. May return none when the area has no labelled examples.
tools.name: get_examples

tools.description:
Read a square window of side_m metres centred on lon/lat from a scene, resampled to out_px x out_px.
        effective_gsd_m = max(side_m / out_px, pixel_spacing_m) is the detail you actually see (upsampling
        adds none); the image follows the metadata.

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.

tools.description:
Keep scored cells with score >= threshold and merge touching kept cells (8- or 4-neighbour) into sites.
Returns sites, unreviewed grid area, and a count range. low counts sites at or above the higher of the
threshold and the 75th percentile of kept scores; high counts all sites. scored_cells: [{cell_id, score}].
tools.name: aggregate

tools.description:
Build (or reuse) a grid of embedding cells for a source, cell size (m) and year over aoi_bbox (default:
the task AOI). Returns an index_id, the cell count and provenance. Only allow-listed sources.
tools.name: build_index

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe or linear_svm returns at most k cells (default 200, maximum 1000), ranked by score
descending then cell_id, plus total cells scored and min/median/max. Explicit cell_ids limit the scored
set. method vision_subagent sends a 0.5 m GSI aerial photo of each cell (Japan only) to a vision model
and returns per-cell label, confidence-based score and explanation; it requires explicit cell_ids
(maximum 20) and may be unconfigured. Use it to check embedding candidates visually.
tools.name: classify

tools.description:

        adds none); the image follows the metadata.
